sections.title: 从电芯不一致性到运维行动
paragraphs: 电池储能系统（BESSs）对电力系统稳定性日益重要，但摘要指出，其运维仍以被动响应和依赖专家诊断为主。电芯层面的不一致性可能预示退化与安全风险；难点在于，如何把这些定量信号转化为规模化、可解释的实际行动。
研究聚焦的正是这一衔接问题：让常规监测数据不止用于发现异常，还能形成面向运维决策的指导。摘要将其称为“不一致性驱动”的大型 BESS 运维范式。

paragraphs: 框架将多维不一致性评估与基于大语言模型的语义推理结合，意在连接定量诊断与实际维护决策。摘要提到，电气、热和老化相关的不一致性先被整理为结构化运维记录，再经多智能体框架转化为维护洞见。
验证所用数据来自一套正在运行的电池系统，覆盖八个月现场数据、共 3,564 个电芯。摘要没有进一步说明各处理环节的具体算法、智能体分工或运维查询的构成，因此不宜据此补写实现细节。

core.title: Attention-enhanced variational learning for physically informed discovery of exceptionally hard multicomponent bulk metallic glasses
core.abstract: Abstract The discovery of high-performance multicomponent alloys is constrained by the vastness of composition space and the scarcity of experimentally validated data. We develop VIBANN, a variational information bottleneck-augmented attention-based neural network framework, for uncertainty-aware inverse design of exceptionally hard bulk multicomponent metallic glasses. The model learns chemically structured latent representations of alloy composition and indentation load to search the candidate space under constraints of chemical plausibility, novelty, and predictive uncertainty. Guided by this framework, we synthesize five B-Nb-Fe-W-Co/Hf/Ru/Zr-rich bulk multicomponent metallic glasses. All alloys form fully amorphous rods of 2 mm diameter and reach Vickers hardness values of about 2450 HV, among the highest reported for bulk metallic glasses under comparable conditions. Latent space analysis, attribution trends, and molecular dynamics-based atomistic simulations show that exceptional hardness in this compositional space arises from dense atomic packing, boron-enriched short-range environments and refractory-stabilized local rigidity. Together, we show that uncertainty-aware latent space learning can discover bulk metallic glasses that combine amorphous structure with exceptionally high hardness under limited data conditions.
core.summary: 本文针对多组元合金成分空间庞大、实验数据稀缺且极值硬度难以可靠外推的问题，提出VIBANN，将自注意力、变分信息瓶颈、潜空间生成与不确定性筛选结合。作者以该框架设计并实验制备五种硼、铌、铁及难熔元素富集的块体金属玻璃，报告其形成直径2 mm的非晶棒材，A1在0.5 N下实测硬度2447±44 HV。模拟与结构表征显示，高硬度与致密堆积及局部结构特征相关。

core.title: Algebraic language models for inverse design of metamaterials via diffusion transformers
core.abstract: Abstract Generative machine learning models have revolutionized material discovery by capturing complex structure–property relationships, yet extending these approaches to the inverse design of three-dimensional metamaterials remains limited by computational complexity and underexplored design spaces due to the lack of expressive representations. Here we present DiffuMeta, a generative framework integrating diffusion transformers with an algebraic language representation, encoding three-dimensional geometries as mathematical sentences. This compact, unified parameterization spans diverse topologies, enabling the direct application of transformers to structural design. DiffuMeta leverages diffusion models to generate new shell structures with precisely targeted stress–strain responses under large deformations, accounting for buckling and contact while addressing the inherent one-to-many mapping by producing diverse solutions. Uniquely, our approach enables simultaneous control over multiple mechanical objectives, including linear and nonlinear responses beyond training domains. Experimental validation of fabricated structures further confirms the efficacy of our approach for accelerated design of metamaterials and structures with tailored properties.

core.title: Fingerprinting organic molecules for the inverse design of two-dimensional hybrid perovskites with target energetics
core.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)–assisted workflows have transformed materials discovery, enabling rapid exploration of chemical spaces of functional materials. Endowed with extraordinary optoelectronic properties, two-dimensional (2D) hybrid perovskites represent an exciting frontier, but current efforts to design 2D perovskites rely heavily on trial-and-error and expert intuition approaches, leaving most of the chemical space unexplored and compromising the design of hybrid materials with desired properties. Here, we introduce an inverse design workflow for Dion-Jacobson perovskites that is built on an invertible fingerprint representation for millions of conjugated diammonium organic spacers. By incorporating high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) calculations, interpretable machine learning, and synthesis feasibility screening, we identified promising organic spacer candidates with deterministic energy level alignment between the organic and the inorganic motifs in the 2D hybrid perovskites. These results highlight the power of integrating invertible, physically meaningful molecular representations into AI-assisted design, streamlining the property-targeted design of hybrid materials.

core.title: Sample-efficient generative molecular design using memory manipulation
core.abstract: Abstract Generative molecular design for drug discovery has recently achieved a wave of experimental validation. Language models operating on string-based representations of molecules are amongst the most successful architectures. The most important factor for downstream success is whether an in silico oracle (computational predictor of a molecule property) is well correlated with the desired end point (such as binding affinity). To this end, current methods use cheaper proxy oracles with a higher throughput before evaluating the most promising subset with high-fidelity oracles. The ability to directly generate molecules with optimal properties as predicted by high-fidelity oracles (computationally expensive simulations with greater predictive accuracy) could greatly enhance generative design and improve hit rates. However, current models are not efficient enough to consider such a prospect, exemplifying the sample efficiency problem. Recently, the Mamba architecture has been proposed as an alternative to transformers, which are widely used in large language models. Existing works have validated Mamba’s performance on tasks spanning natural language completion to biology foundation models. In this work, we introduce a framework called Saturn, which demonstrates the application of the Mamba architecture for generative molecular design. Here we elucidate how experience replay with data augmentation improves the sample efficiency and how Mamba intensifies the effect of this mechanism. Next, we show that Mamba with experience replay outperforms 16 models on multiparameter optimization tasks relevant to drug discovery and possesses sufficient sample efficiency to directly optimize density functional theory simulations as a high-fidelity oracle.

作者据此提出，这一框架为电池储能系统智能运维提供了可扩展路径，并指出其可能关联系统可靠性、安全性及储能的经济性整合。这些是摘要所述的应用意义，不等同于已逐项验证上述长期效果。

papers.title: Attention-enhanced variational learning for physically informed discovery of exceptionally hard multicomponent bulk metallic glasses
papers.abstract: Abstract The discovery of high-performance multicomponent alloys is constrained by the vastness of composition space and the scarcity of experimentally validated data. We develop VIBANN, a variational information bottleneck-augmented attention-based neural network framework, for uncertainty-aware inverse design of exceptionally hard bulk multicomponent metallic glasses. The model learns chemically structured latent representations of alloy composition and indentation load to search the candidate space under constraints of chemical plausibility, novelty, and predictive uncertainty. Guided by this framework, we synthesize five B-Nb-Fe-W-Co/Hf/Ru/Zr-rich bulk multicomponent metallic glasses. All alloys form fully amorphous rods of 2 mm diameter and reach Vickers hardness values of about 2450 HV, among the highest reported for bulk metallic glasses under comparable conditions. Latent space analysis, attribution trends, and molecular dynamics-based atomistic simulations show that exceptional hardness in this compositional space arises from dense atomic packing, boron-enriched short-range environments and refractory-stabilized local rigidity. Together, we show that uncertainty-aware latent space learning can discover bulk metallic glasses that combine amorphous structure with exceptionally high hardness under limited data conditions.
papers.summary: 本文针对多组元合金成分空间庞大、实验数据稀缺且极值硬度难以可靠外推的问题，提出VIBANN，将自注意力、变分信息瓶颈、潜空间生成与不确定性筛选结合。作者以该框架设计并实验制备五种硼、铌、铁及难熔元素富集的块体金属玻璃，报告其形成直径2 mm的非晶棒材，A1在0.5 N下实测硬度2447±44 HV。模拟与结构表征显示，高硬度与致密堆积及局部结构特征相关。

papers.title: Algebraic language models for inverse design of metamaterials via diffusion transformers
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative machine learning models have revolutionized material discovery by capturing complex structure–property relationships, yet extending these approaches to the inverse design of three-dimensional metamaterials remains limited by computational complexity and underexplored design spaces due to the lack of expressive representations. Here we present DiffuMeta, a generative framework integrating diffusion transformers with an algebraic language representation, encoding three-dimensional geometries as mathematical sentences. This compact, unified parameterization spans diverse topologies, enabling the direct application of transformers to structural design. DiffuMeta leverages diffusion models to generate new shell structures with precisely targeted stress–strain responses under large deformations, accounting for buckling and contact while addressing the inherent one-to-many mapping by producing diverse solutions. Uniquely, our approach enables simultaneous control over multiple mechanical objectives, including linear and nonlinear responses beyond training domains. Experimental validation of fabricated structures further confirms the efficacy of our approach for accelerated design of metamaterials and structures with tailored properties.
papers.summary: 本文提出DiffuMeta，将三维壳超材料的隐式几何方程表示为代数token序列，并用扩散Transformer学习结构与力学性能之间复杂关系。作者报告其可针对非线性应力–应变响应及有效泊松比进行条件生成，并处理训练分布外的目标组合；有限元分析和3D打印压缩实验用于验证设计效果。论文同时指出，目标须在物理可达设计空间内，当前生成过程尚未显式纳入物理约束。

papers.title: Fingerprinting organic molecules for the inverse design of two-dimensional hybrid perovskites with target energetics
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)–assisted workflows have transformed materials discovery, enabling rapid exploration of chemical spaces of functional materials. Endowed with extraordinary optoelectronic properties, two-dimensional (2D) hybrid perovskites represent an exciting frontier, but current efforts to design 2D perovskites rely heavily on trial-and-error and expert intuition approaches, leaving most of the chemical space unexplored and compromising the design of hybrid materials with desired properties. Here, we introduce an inverse design workflow for Dion-Jacobson perovskites that is built on an invertible fingerprint representation for millions of conjugated diammonium organic spacers. By incorporating high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) calculations, interpretable machine learning, and synthesis feasibility screening, we identified promising organic spacer candidates with deterministic energy level alignment between the organic and the inorganic motifs in the 2D hybrid perovskites. These results highlight the power of integrating invertible, physically meaningful molecular representations into AI-assisted design, streamlining the property-targeted design of hybrid materials.
papers.summary: 本文针对二维 Dion–Jacobson（DJ）杂化钙钛矿有机间隔分子的探索依赖试错、难以定向获得目标能级排列的问题，提出以可逆的 12 位分子指纹连接结构与性质。作者结合分子形变生成、高通量 DFT、可解释机器学习和合成可行性筛选，并通过约束指纹开展逆向搜索，报告了 Ib、IIa、IIb 类型候选。研究展示了面向目标性质的材料设计流程，但候选主要由计算预测，作者明确指出实验合成与能级表征尚未完成。

papers.title: Sample-efficient generative molecular design using memory manipulation
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative molecular design for drug discovery has recently achieved a wave of experimental validation. Language models operating on string-based representations of molecules are amongst the most successful architectures. The most important factor for downstream success is whether an in silico oracle (computational predictor of a molecule property) is well correlated with the desired end point (such as binding affinity). To this end, current methods use cheaper proxy oracles with a higher throughput before evaluating the most promising subset with high-fidelity oracles. The ability to directly generate molecules with optimal properties as predicted by high-fidelity oracles (computationally expensive simulations with greater predictive accuracy) could greatly enhance generative design and improve hit rates. However, current models are not efficient enough to consider such a prospect, exemplifying the sample efficiency problem. Recently, the Mamba architecture has been proposed as an alternative to transformers, which are widely used in large language models. Existing works have validated Mamba’s performance on tasks spanning natural language completion to biology foundation models. In this work, we introduce a framework called Saturn, which demonstrates the application of the Mamba architecture for generative molecular design. Here we elucidate how experience replay with data augmentation improves the sample efficiency and how Mamba intensifies the effect of this mechanism. Next, we show that Mamba with experience replay outperforms 16 models on multiparameter optimization tasks relevant to drug discovery and possesses sufficient sample efficiency to directly optimize density functional theory simulations as a high-fidelity oracle.
papers.summary: 本文提出 Saturn，将 Mamba 语言模型与强化学习、经验回放及 SMILES 增强结合，用于预算受限的生成式分子优化。作者分析了样本效率与分子多样性的权衡，并在蛋白靶点多参数优化及 DFT 电子性质优化中进行评估。结果显示，Saturn 在若干优化指标上表现突出，但局部利用可能牺牲多样性，且其对更高精度结合亲和力评估及分子可合成性的适用性仍有待验证。[P1–P9]

deep_read.problem: [P1–P2] 论文关注生成式分子设计中的样本效率问题：高保真 oracle 计算昂贵，通常只能先用较便宜的代理评估筛选候选。作者进一步考察如何在有限 oracle 预算下直接优化目标，并分析生成质量、评估成本与分子多样性之间的关系；本文没有直接研究运维或结构可靠性问题。
deep_read.method: [P2–P6][P9] Saturn 以 Mamba 作为 SMILES 自回归生成骨干，结合强化学习、经验回放和 SMILES 随机化增强；回放缓冲区保存高奖励分子，并可选用遗传算法。评估包括 toy MPO、五个蛋白靶点的 docking 目标，以及 DFT 计算的 HOMO–LUMO gap 优化；各实验预算和种子数依任务而异。
deep_read.innovation: [P3–P5][P9] 作者的主要贡献是提出 Saturn 框架，并解释 Augmented Memory 的作用机制：增强回放分子的不同 SMILES 表达会提高相应生成可能性。论文还将 Mamba 的生成行为概括为“hop and locally exploit”，并系统讨论批量大小、增强轮数与多样性之间的关联；这些是作者在本文实验范围内提出的解释。
deep_read.findings: [P2–P8][P13–P14] 作者报告增加增强轮数通常可提高样本效率，但可能降低多样性；加入遗传算法有助于维持多样性，产率提升则较有限。Saturn 在若干 docking 与严格筛选指标上表现较好，并在 DFT 案例中将 HOMO–LUMO gap 分布推向较低值。扩展表格提供了架构效率和 novel hit ratio 的比较证据。
deep_read.limitations: [P8–P9] 作者指出，本文尚未将 Saturn 验证于准确度更高的结合亲和力 oracle，且仅用合成可及性分数不足以充分判断分子是否可合成。局部利用也未必适用于所有目标；面对活性悬崖时，相似分子可能具有显著不同的性质。资料未报告原文件缺项，故此处没有可确认的缺页或缺公式需要补列。
deep_read.connection: [P2–P9] 【解读】本文与智能运维、结构设计和可靠性研究没有直接实验联系。其有限预算下结合回放、代理或高保真评估以及探索—利用权衡的思路，可能为其他昂贵目标优化提供方法参考；但迁移到工程领域的有效性不能由本文结果直接推出，仍需针对任务验证。
deep_read.next_steps: [P9] 【建议】可在新的工程优化问题中，将昂贵仿真设为高保真评估器，比较回放与探索策略对预算利用和解集多样性的影响；尤其应设计能识别目标突变或局部失效的评估，并报告重复实验及不确定性。此为研究设想，不是作者已完成或验证的工作。
